description:
Advances: specled.append_only

Severity: Medium. detect_statement_rewritten/2 (lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex:202-217) alone among the detectors returns a bare list instead of {findings, consulted_ids}, so its ids are unioned into neither weakened_ids nor consulted_ids (:89, :97-101, :108-112).

Failure: rewriting a security-relevant MUST in place — keeping the id and priority: must — emits one non-blocking warning, requires no authorizing ADR, is never flagged same_pr_self_authorization, and never triggers missing_change_type. Deleting the same requirement is an error. This branch demonstrated the asymmetry against itself: gh_pages_privilege_separation was caught only because it also crossed polarity.

Why not on the release branch: which set to union into is a policy call. consulted_ids alone (so missing_change_type fires) is the conservative fix; also unioning into weakened_ids puts rewrites under authorizing_decision/3 and the self-auth markers, which is a stricter gate than 0.15.0 shipped. The budget ADR append_only_finding_budget_v3 should record whichever is chosen and why.

Source: 2026-08-12 critical review security M2.
title: statement_rewritten ids reach neither weakened_ids nor consulted_ids
